game_title: C Archive · Ritchie and Bell Labs
game_concept: A survival strategy set in Shadow Cave – Spider Den, a webbed spider den: the shadow ranger must handle rock golems while practicing control flow: while loops. Core idea – Countdown Launch: Tick a countdown down each loop until it hits zero and the launch fires.
theme: Shadow Cave – Spider Den: a webbed spider den
core_gameplay_loop: Solve the CP1 stations in the shared Canvas shell while the Week 4 game theme awaits course approval.
secondary_mechanics: Hint tokens that reveal one line of code
player_objective: Archive variation 2: classify and verify C history, characteristics and language categories for Ritchie and Bell Labs.
controls: Read each archive record and choose the supported C fact.
win_condition: All researched archive facts are correctly identified.
lose_condition: count drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 46-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: CP1 Week 4: Ritchie and Bell Labs
assets_style: Shared Kenney CC0 tile and audio assets with deterministic Canvas layouts; assets are not duplicated per game.
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Countdown Launch' (Week 4 slot 2), mission type 'Survival Siege', and setting 'Spider Den'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how count changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against rock golems in Spider Den.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Timer reaches 46 seconds while count > 0.
source_player_objective: Protect the stone seal from rock golems in Spider Den: keep the count meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 46-second timer ends.
